It was caused by an undiagnosed massive cancerous tumour in her back that the GP should’ve picked up on. She frequently rang them in pain and she was high risk having cancer previously. The cancer returned and spread through her body; in her bones and near the aorta it had spread that much. She didn’t make it to even see the oncology team as the cancer and surgery from the perforated bowel had finished her off. She had a cardiac arrest and I had to watch the closest person I had die infront of me for 70+ hours until we had no choice but to let her go.
